title: 50% off + $0 Delivery on Your First 2 Orders (Max $20 off Per Order, Fees Apply) @ DoorDash (New Customers)
body:
Deal: 50% off + $0 Delivery on Your First 2 Orders (Max $20 off Per Order, Fees Apply) @ DoorDash (New Customers)

[askbargain] Make sure to do the second order quickly. Otherwise the original code will run out and a new code will be invalid.
[cheapvn] Because you will not be considered new customer for your 2nd order.
both orders need to be used same time.
[tunzafun001] Well, that explains why my second order a week later was full price (didn't place it).
[cheapvn] Last one still working. Just used it for costco orders.
[sunny007] Can you link single costco membership with multiple DD account?
[cheapvn] Need to change customer name same to your costco membership.
[CasperLeon22] "The promotion cannot be applied to this order. Please remove or use another promotion code." Any ideas?
[cheapvn] Did you use new phone number, new email address, new payment method (Doordash credits work) method?
[cheapvn] try placing a cheap schedule pick up items <$1.
and again try apply promo code on your current order.
[meow007] what about doordash credits and i also get this same error
[jimbler] Are there any $1 sim deals at the moment? I need a new number…
[doodlejones] Isn’t this unfair terms and conditions? Giving offer of 50% off first two orders which in-turn only applies to very first order .
